name: Pork Paprikash
time: ~8 hr 30 min, ~30 min hands-on (mostly slow cooker; estimated)

items: 2 lb boneless pork shoulder, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps.title: Slow cook the pork
steps.body: Place **2 lb boneless pork shoulder**, cut in 1-inch pieces, **1 cup chopped onion**, **2 Tbsp butter**, **3 cloves garlic**, minced, **1 tsp caraway seed**, **2 Tbsp paprika**, **1 tsp salt** and **3 cups sauerkraut**, rinsed and drained, in a crockpot on low for 8-10 hours.

steps.title: Add the flour and sour cream
steps.body: When meat is tender, mix together **1 Tbsp flour** and **2 cups sour cream**, and add to meat.

steps.title: Add the tomato sauce
steps.body: Add **8–15 oz tomato sauce** and **2 Tbsp vinegar**, then sugar, salt and pepper to give it a zing to your taste.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Cook 10 minutes more, and serve over buttered egg noodles or rice.
